title: Rollers rise
description: A wrapper that fades its content in while lifting it 40px (or sliding it 60px in from the right) over the first stretch of scroll after it enters the window. Steps stagger items set side by side. CSS view timeline.
notes: CSS only: without support, and under reduced motion, the content shows in place
sliding in from the right can push past the page edge while it runs: give the section overflow-x-clip
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box (use overflow-clip), or the timeline freezes
